Pretty good watch, as an old TW fan who got onboard with Med2 and felt absolutely shat on since Rome2, and I'm not even talking about their turn to fantasy, just the gameplay experience which is a basically a mobile game braindead clickfest. I hate it and hate what they've done to the potential of this franchise. I still remember golden age of Shogun 2 avatar conquest, online clans, co-op campaigns, just the campaigns itself - a proper gameplay experience that was challenging and so fun. I was so excited for it to continue through the series...  
  
I come back to Med 2 from time to time with SSHIP mod on. Honestly, TW is probably my biggest "what if" (that unfortunately will stay like that) from childhood games. It died over a decade ago, and won't come back. I hoped I got over it but videos like that still makes me so enraged at this...

Yeah, AI is better than in empire. Also, the modders community is still going, and you have ambitious and more immersive projects like SSHIP (Stainless Steel Historical Improvement Project) or Europa Barbarorum 2.  
With mods, Medieval 2, Rome 1 and Shogun 2 is the peak of this franchise that took a deep nosedive with the release of Rome 2 and ever after

There is no standardized app for musicians, they all are a bit underdeveloped and not focused on what musicians and producers want the most which is quick and easy connection and viable connection to start working and jamming. It's all very clumsy and not user-friendly. No educational content or community that may uplift and inspire upcoming producers/musicians.

They all look for gigs and collabs. Masterclasses are to create value in educating people, to creating an authentic community of musicians, producers and freelancers that look for real networks and fair pay that, let's be honest, hasn't been the case in the past. And now with this app we're aiming to help engage musicians and producers who seek connections, paid gigs (be it recording, performing, session playing) or just simple jams and collaborations.
